2024-06-16
Claim opened after a rear-end collision reported by the insured driver, who was stopped at a signal when the vehicle
behind struck the rear bumper. Police attended the scene and the insured's report was recorded on arrival.
2024-08-11
The other driver's statement matches the insured's account of how the impact occurred. Two independent witnesses
at the intersection also describe the sequence in the same way.
2024-08-12
Photographs taken at the scene and the damage seen on inspection are consistent with the described impact. Rear
bumper, tailgate and lamp assembly show the damage expected from this type of collision.
2024-08-15
Records show no prior damage to the vehicle in this area and no earlier claims on it. Nothing indicates the damage
predates the start of the current policy period.
2024-08-31
The insured reports a knee injury from the impact. The claimant has since instructed legal representation, and all
further contact will go through their office.
2024-10-15
The claimant has provided a follow-up account that adds a few smaller details about the seating position and the
moment of impact. The core sequence of events has remained the same across each version given.
2024-11-09
Medical records show treatment for the knee that continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury.
Nothing in the history shows any earlier problem with the same knee, and the injury is consistent with a collision of
this kind.
2024-12-16
The driver is a household member of the policyholder and is covered under the policy as such. Police and witness
statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time, and the claim is progressing to settlement review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
